column1: # CI model enrollment registry.  TAB-separated.  '#' lines and blanks ignored.
# Columns:
#   1  model_key   folder name under geak_runtime/ (also the handoff dir)
#   2  hf_repo     HuggingFace repo id for auto-download of weights, or '-' if
#                  weights must be pre-staged on the cluster (no auto-download)
#   3  tier        'smoke' -> used by the l1-ci-smoke L1 smoke (single model)
#                  'verify'-> used only by the l1-ci-full full matrix
#                  (the smoke model is ALSO part of the full matrix)
# framework (vllm/sglang) and tp (GPU count) are NOT listed here — they are the
# single source of truth in each model's handoff.json and read from there.
# Enrollment is intentionally limited to models with FULL GEAK input material
# (handoff + launch_recipe + tracelens + torch_trace) per geak_ci_workspace/TABLE.md.
# Add a row here only once a model's material is complete.

#     auto-downloads: stage_weights requires GEAK_ALLOW_DOWNLOAD=1). framework +
#     tp come from each handoff.json. The 'smoke' row is ALSO in the full matrix,
